summary.headline: 7700 is the main 0DTE inventory and volatility decision center above spot
key_points: 7700 carries about $23.96M gross premium and combines synthetic-long-like delta transfer, long-vol buying and opposing synthetic-short-like flow.
7665-7685 is the first upside transition band; acceptance through it is needed before 7700 inventory can become upside realization.
7650-7640 is the immediate battle zone; raw put buying is materially affected by linked spreads.
7625 is the downside protection activation area, while 7600 is a conditional floor created partly by tail-risk financing.
Acceptance below 7600 would invalidate the supportive reading of the lower structure and requires a fresh 0DTE tape for the next downside route.
summary.daily_note: Overnight baseline: mixed / 7700-centered inventory. Below 7700 the book is not a proven bullish signal. Reclaim 7665 then 7680-7685 is the first improvement; acceptance above 7700 activates upside realization toward 7710-7715. Failed reclaim below 7640 opens 7625 then 7600. Below 7600 the current tape has no clean next protection node.

leave_one_out.comment: Removing only the largest deep-ITM 4500C buy flips raw net calls negative, but the print is paired with an equal-size 4550C sell at the same timestamp.

paired_complex_adjustment.comment: Removing both linked deep-ITM legs leaves net calls near the original aggregate, so the pair should not drive the directional read.

levels.label: MAIN 0DTE INVENTORY / VOLATILITY CENTER
levels.interpretation: Largest economically relevant near-market premium center. Repeated synthetic-long-like transfer, long-straddle-like buying and some opposing synthetic-short-like flow make 7700 a decision level rather than a simple directional target.

notes: About $23.96M gross visible premium at strike
Spot at snapshot basis is about 53.3 points below strike

levels.label: UPSIDE TRANSITION / CALL DEMAND
levels.interpretation: First meaningful upside transition zone between current spot and 7700. 7680 calls show material net buying, but the surrounding band also contains put activity and complex spreads.

notes: Use acceptance through 7680-7685 as an early upside confirmation, not as a standalone target

levels.label: FIRST UPSIDE DEMAND NODE
levels.interpretation: Local call-demand node and first step in the route toward 7680-7700.

notes: 7665 calls net bought about $466K after exact-row deduplication

levels.label: IMMEDIATE DECISION / MIXED PUT INVENTORY
levels.interpretation: Large local put turnover mixes outright protection with put-credit-spread-like risk acceptance. Treat as a decision area rather than unconditional support.

notes: About $4.0M gross visible premium at strike
7650 puts net bought about $788K, but linked spreads materially change the economic read

levels.label: LOWER IMMEDIATE PIVOT
levels.interpretation: Late downside management concentrated around 7640. A failed reclaim below this zone is the first bearish realization trigger in the baseline map.

notes: Multiple late complex packages use 7640 as a downside leg

levels.label: DOWNSIDE PROTECTION ACTIVATION
levels.interpretation: Protection begins to become more explicit around 7625, including a late ratio-like package financed by short 7600 puts.

notes: Late 40x 7625P buy versus 60x 7600P sell links 7625 protection to 7600 tail-risk acceptance

levels.label: CONDITIONAL LOWER FLOOR / TAIL FINANCING
levels.interpretation: Short-put financing makes 7600 a conditional floor while price remains above it. Acceptance below 7600 can turn the same structure from supportive risk acceptance into destabilizing tail exposure.

notes: Visible 7600 put flow is sold rather than bought in the key late package
No clean next downside protection target is established below 7600 in this snapshot

structures.interpretation: Near-simultaneous equal-size deep-ITM call legs. This package explains why single-print leave-one-out flips raw call net; as a linked complex it is largely self-offsetting and should not drive the directional map.

Conservative aggregation of clearly matched or near-matched 7700 call-buy/put-sell packages. Additional nearby matched-size prints may raise the probable total, but are excluded from the conservative leg count. Indicates large delta inventory transfer, not proven opening bullish positioning.

Repeated same-strike call-and-put buying with matched sizes totals about 900 contracts in the conservative set. Economic read is paid movement/volatility around 7700 rather than a directional forecast.
Opposing synthetic-short-like packages exist at the same central strike. They reinforce the interpretation of 7700 as a two-sided inventory center rather than a one-way bullish bet.
Equal-size lower-put buy / higher-put sell package is consistent with a put credit spread. It is one reason raw 7650 put buying cannot be read as purely bearish protection.
Downside protection at 7625 is partly financed by selling more 7600 puts. Above 7600 this accepts tail risk; below 7600 the financing leg can become destabilizing.

beneficiaries: long-vol structures if price realizes away from strike
monetization_zones.description: 7700 is the dominant inventory center. Its monetization is conditional on whether price reclaims and accepts the strike or remains below it.
monetization_zones.caveat: Opening/closing is unknown and complex-order IDs are absent.

beneficiaries: short-dated spread inventory if price remains inside the band
monetization_zones.description: Immediate battle zone where protection and risk-acceptance structures overlap.
monetization_zones.caveat: Raw put premium cannot be interpreted independently of spread linkage.

monetization_zones.description: Protection activates around 7625 while 7600 short puts finance the package; the economic sign becomes less supportive if 7600 is accepted below.
monetization_zones.caveat: No clean lower protection target is visible below 7600 in this snapshot.

scenarios.name: Downside realization through lower floor

Protection demand expands into the 7625 activation zone
Break the tail-financing strike and invalidate the conditional-floor reading

scenarios.interpretation: Below 7600 this snapshot does not establish a reliable next downside target; a fresh intraday 0DTE tape is required.

caveats: About 94.5% of visible premium is tagged Spread or Block Spread, so individual-leg directional reads are unreliable.
complex_order_id and trade_id are unavailable in the source dump; linked structures are inferred from timestamps, sizes, strikes and economic logic.
The raw column named timezone contains ETH session labels rather than an explicit geographic timezone; source trade timestamps are preserved as given.
Visible tape is filtered at $50k+ and is not the full market position.
